nodes.decision_direction: Maintain your ground army path and continue heavy production and technology. Keep expanding and developing your economy.

nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent's composition is still uncertain, but you may have some scouting information. Be aware of possible pressure or tech plays.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early-midgame with a ground-oriented army. Production is heavy, technology is heavy, and you are expanding. Your army includes Marines, and you may have Thors and Medivacs as you progress.
nodes.strategic_reason: A ground army with heavy production and technology provides a solid foundation for midgame engagements. Continuing to expand ensures a strong economy for sustained production.
nodes.title: Ground Army Transition

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid overcommitting to a single composition without scouting. Be ready to adapt to opponent's tech choices.
nodes.decision_direction: Maintain your current army composition and production. Continue to expand and tech up, but also consider adding air units or upgrades to counter potential threats.

nodes.next_state_summary: Continue to develop your army and economy, adapting to opponent's moves.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent's composition is still uncertain, but you may have scouted some units. Be prepared for potential tech switches or large engagements.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the midgame with a heavy ground army, including Marines, Thors, and Medivacs. Production and technology are heavy, and you have a strong defensive posture. Your economy is strong with multiple expansions.

nodes.title: Midgame Consolidation
